name: resource-balance
title: Resource Balance
author: funtik13
description: A floating panel that shows produced, consumed and balance per minute for the items and fluids you pick — per planet or summed over all planets and platforms. A watcher alerts you when a line stops or runs short, a stock column shows how long logistic networks last, "what changed" explains a drop, and the per-recipe breakdown shows idle machines and jumps to them. Trend charts, a large chart and comparison of up to 4 resources. Made for overhaul mods like Pyanodon's.
